wait_helper.condition: Repeat signed comparison while shared counter > argument r4; no service call inside wait.

decrement_callback.operation: Counter decremented with 32-bit wrap; extra callbacks when result equals zero.

initialization.operation: Store r4 in initial and current countdown, r5 in iteration limit, zero iteration index, register decrement callback, invoke 0x8c055c44.
